name: Cheryl Brown (Cheryl Fenner Brown)
reason: Health rule: her work is mainly condition-led. Her own About page (yogacheryl.com/about) says her work has moved toward oncology teacher training; her flagship CEC training, her book (Yoga Therapy across the Cancer Care Continuum), a 'Cancer' menu section and her one-on-one sessions are framed around cancer treatment side-effects (pain, insomnia, anxiety, lymphedema, neuropathy). A contact route does exist now (cherylbrownyoga@gmail.com, Cloudflare-encoded on yogacheryl.com/contact; base Bahama, North Carolina), and some clean yoga nidra and chakra courses exist, so the owner may want to reconsider.
